editorial.meta_description: ACE-CPT exam guide covering 150 questions across 5 domains for aspiring personal trainers, with $249 fee and 165-minute duration.
editorial.overview: The ACE Personal Trainer (ACE-CPT) exam is administered by ACE Fitness and certifies entry-level personal trainers. It covers five domains: interviews and assessments, program design and implementation, progression and modifications, professional conduct and safety, and nutrition and weight management. Candidates must hold current CPR/AED certification as a prerequisite and demonstrate readiness to work safely with clients.
editorial.who_should_take: Aspiring personal trainers preparing for client-facing fitness work should pursue the ACE-CPT. It suits candidates who have completed or are completing a fitness training program and need a recognized credential to begin working with general-population clients in gyms or studios.
skills_summary: Conducting client interviews and fitness assessments
Maintaining professional conduct and safety standards
Providing nutrition and weight management guidance
editorial.preparation_strategy: Build a study plan that covers all five domains, weighting time toward program design and nutrition. Use the official ACE study materials and practice multiple-choice questions to build pacing for 150 items in 165 minutes. Confirm CPR/AED certification before scheduling, and review the Dietary Guidelines for Americans to ground the nutrition domain.

domain_guidance.summary: This domain covers the skills needed to gather client information through interviews and assessments before designing any program. It establishes the baseline data a trainer uses to make safe, individualized recommendations.

This domain addresses how to translate assessment findings into a structured exercise program. It focuses on selecting exercises, sets, reps, and training variables that align with client goals and current fitness levels.
This domain covers how to progress, regress, or modify exercises based on client response over time. It ensures trainers can adjust programs safely as clients adapt or encounter limitations.

This domain addresses professional responsibilities, including scope of practice, client safety, and risk management. It covers how trainers maintain ethical conduct and respond to emergencies in a fitness setting.

This domain covers basic nutrition and weight management concepts a personal trainer needs to support client goals. It draws on public-health guidance such as the Dietary Guidelines for Americans to frame food-group recommendations.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Arrive early with valid ID and proof of current CPR/AED certification. Pace yourself across 150 multiple-choice questions in 165 minutes, flagging uncertain items to revisit. Read each question carefully before selecting an answer.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The ACE-CPT exam contains 150 multiple-choice questions delivered in a linear format. Candidates have 165 minutes to complete the full question set, so pacing matters across the five domains.
The passing score for the ACE-CPT is 500 on ACE's scaled scoring system. This score applies to the full 150-question exam and is required to earn the credential.
The ACE-CPT exam runs 165 minutes, which is just under three hours. Candidates should plan their pacing across all five domains to finish within the allotted time.

faq.question_title: How much does the ACE-CPT exam cost?
faq.answer_text: The exam-only fee is $249, and a bundle that includes study materials is priced at $399. Candidates must also hold a current CPR/AED certification before sitting for the exam.

faq.question_title: How long is the certification valid?
faq.answer_text: The ACE-CPT credential is valid for 2 years from the date of issue. Renewal is required, and ACE Fitness sets the current continuing education requirements for maintaining the credential.

faq.question_title: Is the ACE-CPT exam still current?
faq.answer_text: Yes, the ACE-CPT is a current credential offered by ACE Fitness. For any long-term certification path questions, check with ACE Fitness for the latest requirements.

methodology.summary: This page was built from verified ACE Fitness facts and official source documentation, including the certification landing page and study materials. Each domain summary was written to match its stated scope.
